verdict: RE-COURT VERDICT (2026-08-21, principal-directed): REJECT — but the reason is the TAIL, not the price. At the corrected numbers SRAD is NOT expensive: ~11.2x EV/EBITDA (EV honestly rebuilt with the EUR1.11B non-current rights payables and actual cash of EUR251.1M) for a 19-21% cc grower, and the 50% street-to-tape gap is real. What binds is RP_TAINTED: an S.D.N.Y. fraud complaint alleging 20-40% of revenue is black-market, rebutted only by a management-scoped review (attestation != audit), with governance and the allegation concentrated in the same person (dual-class control in the founder/CEO the short reports name). An unbounded left tail cannot be cured by price — the 0.85xE[fv] cap nominally passes ($15.7 vs $12.40), which is exactly why the gate must bind on the tail rather than the arithmetic. The gap is carry for a legal binary we hold no edge in. RED's strongest surviving legs: the prediction-market leg is the CAUSE of the guide cut, not unpriced upside (guide cut EUR44.5M rev / EUR30M EBITDA on PM deal slippage); reported growth is materially inorganic (IMG, a NEGATIVE-consideration acquisition — Endeavor paid ~$225M to hand it over — anniversarying 11/03, one day before the print); the buyback destroyed capital at $16-20 vs a $12.40 tape while cash fell EUR114M in six months. BLUE's corrections: red's 'no divergence' and P/E-203 legs overturned (estimate-agreement is not price-agreement; a loss has no P/E); red cherry-picked the H1 column where Q2 contradicted it. BLUE's new findings: the cut guide STILL embeds H2 acceleration (H2 must deliver 61% of FY EBITDA at +25% revenue vs H1's +15%) and the implied incremental margin on the deferred PM revenue is 67% — the one number that would make re-completion high-octane; plus a quadrennial World Cup comp stacking on the IMG anniversary within twelve months.
